footer.line: SEGP Group 012. Prototype for supervisor feedback.

headline: Stories about online life.
You choose.
Then you say why.
home.lede: A short interactive story for adults. Three decisions, two written answers, about ten minutes. No points. No scores. Just your thinking.
home.dioramaCaption: The room in scene 1. The phone pings every 6 seconds. Move the pointer or tilt your phone to look around.
home.howSub: Four steps. You can stop at any time.

steps.title: Tell us a little.
steps.text: Share an online moment, or pick a theme.

steps.title: Make a choice.
steps.text: The story gives you a hard call. Neither option is wrong.

steps.title: Say why.
steps.text: Write a few sentences. The system reads your answer and asks a question that fits it.

steps.title: See what happened.
steps.text: We ask you something first. Then we explain.

sample.title: What a “why” looks like
sample.intro1: After two of the decisions, you write a few sentences. Then you get a short question that fits what you wrote.
sample.intro2: This answer is made up. Yours can be shorter, longer or different.
sample.answer: Lisa posted the photo and Marco and Dev passed it on. I should have said something sooner.
sample.followupBefore: You've said who did what. Can you add
sample.note: Every follow-up is written by the team. The reader only chooses which one to show.

about.title: About and AI use
about.lead: A plain list of how this prototype was made, and what it does with your answers.

rows.t: Story text was drafted with AI help, then reviewed and edited by the team.
Voice lines are made with ElevenLabs from team-approved text.
Characters and scenes are built in code by the team.
In this demo build, answers are read by written rules inside the app. A model API can be switched in later.
Data: anonymous session ID, stored in your browser only. Hosting provider may keep standard request logs.
What this prototype does not do: no claim that it improves learning.

support.title: Need support?
support.lead: This story is fictional, but it can bring up real things. You can stop any time.
support.danger: If you are in danger now, contact local emergency services.
